name: Entity Stretched Link
description: Adds a disabled-by-default 'Stretched Link' display pseudo-field to every entity type/bundle; when enabled on Manage Display it renders an empty core link to the entity with the 'stretched-link' class, making the whole rendered card/teaser clickable.
project_description: A very lightweight module that makes an entire rendered entity (card, teaser, or search result) clickable using the 'stretched link' CSS pattern. It adds an extra display pseudo-field named 'Stretched Link' to every entity type and bundle, disabled by default, which is enabled per view-display on the Manage Display screen. When enabled, the module renders an empty core link element pointing to the entity's canonical URL with the CSS class 'stretched-link' (plus rel=tag and a 'Read more about <title>' title attribute for accessibility). The module ships NO CSS of its own; the site theme must provide a .stretched-link::after absolute-overlay rule (the classic Bootstrap stretched-link definition) for the effect to work.
